title: Way too expensive for what you get.  Thought there would be dishes too.
text: I ate them and did not think they were all that good and absolutely not worth the price.  I would not buy them again and canceled my subscription.  The booklet describing each thing was a nice touch and was very interesting.  I enjoyed that much more than the snacks.  It was packaged nicely and would make a good gift for a person who requires something unique because they have everything.
label: neutral
